_note: Everything the developments map loads, all served from this site. Hashes are checked by scripts/audit_site_consistency.mjs against the files and against the constants in assets/liora/liora-discovery-map.js. To upgrade: npm pack the new version, verify the tarball integrity against the registry (npm view <pkg>@<ver> dist.integrity), replace the files, and update this file and the constants together.
